title: CommitteeParams
description: FOMC committee vote parameters. SPEC-COMM-3: the per-member preferred-rate formula is `inertia * lagged_rate + (1 - inertia) * (neutral_rate + inflation_coef * gap_inflation - output_coef * gap_unemployment)`. Per-member coefficients live on each CommitteeMember; this file holds only the committee-wide constants.

dissent_tolerance.description: Absolute rate difference (decimal, e.g. 0.005 = 50 bp) between a member's preferred rate and the Chair's proposed rate above which the member dissents. Empirical 1979-82 dissent rate of 1-3 per meeting suggests this should be tight enough that dots far from the proposal dissent and members within a couple of standard deviations vote yes.

neutral_rate.description: The nominal policy rate the committee would set at target inflation and natural unemployment. Anchors every member's preferred-rate computation.

target_inflation.description: Long-run inflation target used by all members when computing the inflation gap.

target_unemployment.description: Natural rate of unemployment used by all members when computing the unemployment gap.
